free_tier.stated: No free tier. NAT SG 1GB is Rp 20,000 IDR a month: 1 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 10 GB SSD, 300 GB bandwidth, a shared IPv4 with '20 VDF Records' and Domain Forwarding, OpenVZ 7, Singapore. The plan carries '1 Available' on the store page and the page states 'Tidak ada IPv6' for this Singapore line.

retention.stated: not stated on any page read; the store is WHMCS with monthly billing and no deletion window is published on the product page

egress.terms: 300 GB of bandwidth a month; no overage price and no shaping rule is published on the page read

interface_detail: Root on an OpenVZ 7 container over SSH, reached through the shared IPv4 on the assigned port records. The store states 'Tanpa dukungan teknis' (no technical support) on this product line.
tooling: any SSH client; WHMCS billing panel; no VPS control panel and no API named on the page.
chaining: USD 1.106 a month for 1 GB and 10 GB in Singapore with 20 port records, which is the largest RAM-per-dollar among the NAT rows here; the Singapore location is the reason to pick it over the Indonesian line, and the absence of IPv6 is the reason not to.

limits.value: a shared IPv4 with '20 VDF Records' and Domain Forwarding; no IPv6 on this Singapore product line - the page states 'Tidak ada IPv6'
stock is one unit: the store page reads '1 Available' on this plan, so it is a single remaining instance

binding_note: there is no IPv6 on the Singapore line at all, so every reachable service has to fit inside the 20 port records; the single-unit stock is the second constraint and will bind first in practice.

identity_cost.detail: no card at registration was established; the store is WHMCS and exposes a Register link at my.mnethosting.com-style /register.php and a client area, and no card, ID or phone-verification field appears on the product page read. What the checkout form asks for was NOT read, so the card situation is unverified rather than absent: the vendor publishes no payment-method list on the product page. No card hold or authorisation amount is stated anywhere read.

reliability_note: No reliability event observed. The vendor states 'Tanpa dukungan teknis' (no technical support) on this product and advises against storing important files: 'Tidak disarankan untuk menyimpan file penting'.
confidence_note: the Rp 20,000 monthly price, the shape, the 20 port records, the '1 Available' stock line and the 'Tidak ada IPv6' statement are all quoted from the vendor's own store page read. The registration and payment fields were not read, which is why identity_cost is written as unverified rather than as a claim. 'VDF Records' is the vendor's own phrase and is not expanded anywhere on the page.

evidence.proved: quoted product block: 'NAT SG 1GB | 1 Available | 1GB RAM | 1 vCPU | 10GB SSD | 300GB Bandwidth | Shared IPv4 | 20 VDF Records | Domain Forwarding | OpenVZ 7 | Tanpa dukungan teknis | Tidak disarankan untuk menyimpan file penting | Tidak ada IPv6' with the price line 'Rp20,000 IDR | Monthly | Order Now'
the stock counters on the same page: 'NAT SG 1GB | 1 Available', 'NAT SG 2GB | 1 Available' at 'Rp30,000 IDR', 'NAT SG 4GB | 0 Available'

quoted: 'NAT VPS Singapura Direkomendasikan untuk BOT dan VPN | 1 | 1GB | 50GB SSD | Singapore DC | Rp20K/bulan' and 'VPS dengan Shared IPv4 dan Dedicated IPv6' - the dedicated-IPv6 claim on this index page does not hold for the Singapore line, whose own product page says 'Tidak ada IPv6'

quoted, the row that would have been the better offer and is sold out: 'NAT 1GB | Rp15K bulan | 1GB RAM | 1 vCPU | 15GB SSD NVME | 1 TB Bandwidth | Shared IPv4 | 1 Dedicated IPv6 | 20 VDF Records | Germany, Hetzner', with the store page for it reading '0 Available' on all four rungs

notes: Two things make this a caveat rather than a clean qualification. The stock is one unit, which the vendor's own counter states, so it can be gone by the time anyone reads this. And the identity cost is unverified: the checkout form was not read, so nothing here should be taken as evidence that no card is wanted. The vendor's index page advertises 'Shared IPv4 dan Dedicated IPv6' across the NAT range, but the Singapore product page says 'Tidak ada IPv6' - the product page wins for this plan, and that disagreement is worth recording because it is exactly the kind of claim a table would propagate. 'VDF Records' is unexplained; it sits where a port-forward count would sit and the sibling EU product also prints '20 VDF Records', so it is most likely the port count, but that is an inference and is labelled as one. The better EU offer at Rp15K with a dedicated IPv6 is sold out on all four rungs today.

extras.price_arithmetic: Rp 20,000 IDR a month, billed monthly; 20000 / 18089.973852 = USD 1.1056, rounded to USD 1.106. Rate: 1 USD = IDR 18089.973852 (open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, time_last_update_utc Sat, 24 Oct 2026 00:02:31 +0000). A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so 24/7 and 10 h/day are the same.
